title: OpenAI unveils Lockdown Mode to protect sensitive data from prompt injection attacks
author: Anthony Ha
content_snippet: Even with Lockdown Mode, ChatGPT could be still vulnerable to prompt injections, but the goal is to reduce the likelihood that sensitive data gets shared in the process.
